name: Roland's Doom

intro: Nightbane worgen hold Roland's Doom, east of the Rotting Orchard in southeastern Duskwood. The mine is abandoned, and its tunnels are a dangerous den.

sections.t: A Den of Shadows and Savagery
p: Roland's Doom lies in the ridges east of the Rotting Orchard, where the mine has long stood idle. Nightbane worgen now use its tunnels as a staging ground, under leaders such as Gutspill and Nefaru. Snarls carry through the dark shafts, and the damp earth is stained with blood. Travelers who enter face one of Duskwood's most perilous places.
